summary: Transfer Consignment Stock Of A High-Value Biologic From Vendor-Owned
sapTransaction: Post Goods Movement (Fiori app) - Movement Type 411

acceptanceCriteria.text: The user can access the "Post Goods Movement" Fiori app for consignment withdrawal.
The system tracks consignment stock separately by vendor and batch, excluded from company-owned inventory valuation until withdrawn.
acceptanceCriteria.sapConfig: Special Stock Indicator 'K' (Consignment Stock), MB5K report

acceptanceCriteria.text: Upon withdrawal for production or sale, the system automatically transfers ownership and triggers the liability posting to the vendor.
The system generates a consignment settlement document listing all withdrawals for a defined settlement period.
The settlement document can be used to generate the vendor's invoice verification automatically.
acceptanceCriteria.sapTransaction: MIRO (Invoice Verification) or ERS (Evaluated Receipt Settlement)

acceptanceCriteria.text: The system maintains batch traceability throughout the consignment-to-owned stock transition.

HP.details: Access app → Select valid material/vendor/batch → Enter withdrawal quantity → Post movement → Verify ownership transfer → Verify financial posting → Verify batch traceability maintained

HP.description: Settlement Document Generation and Invoice Creation
HP.details: Execute consignment settlement for period → Verify all withdrawals included → Verify batch details present → Generate invoice automatically → Verify invoice matches settlement → Verify GR/IR clearing

AP.details: Withdraw 50% of available consignment stock → Verify remaining stock still vendor-owned → Verify liability posted only for withdrawn quantity
Withdraw 100% of available consignment stock → Verify consignment stock balance = zero → Verify all stock transferred to company-owned

AP.description: Multiple Batches Withdrawal in Same Period
AP.details: Withdraw Batch A → Withdraw Batch B → Generate settlement → Verify both batches listed separately in settlement document
Withdraw in January and February → Settle for Jan 1 - Feb 28 → Verify all withdrawals included regardless of posting date
Post withdrawal with past posting date (within allowed period) → Verify financial posting uses backdated values → Verify settlement includes backdated withdrawal

NEG.details: Attempt to withdraw quantity > available consignment stock → System rejects with error "Insufficient consignment stock available"
Select Material X, Vendor A, Batch owned by Vendor B → System rejects with error "Batch not found for selected vendor"
NEG.expectedError: Batch not found for selected vendor

NEG.details: Attempt consignment withdrawal for non-consignment material → System rejects with error "Material not enabled for consignment stock"
NEG.expectedError: Material not enabled for consignment stock

NEG.details: User without M_MSEG_BWA authorization attempts to access app → System denies access with authorization error

ERR.details: Enter withdrawal quantity = 0 → System rejects with error "Quantity must be greater than zero"
ERR.expectedError: Quantity must be greater than zero

ERR.details: Enter withdrawal quantity = -10 → System rejects with error "Negative quantities not allowed"
Leave Plant field blank → Attempt to post → System rejects with error "Plant is a required field"
Leave Storage Location field blank → Attempt to post → System rejects with error "Storage Location is required"

EDGE.details: Attempt to withdraw batch with expiry date in the past → System blocks with error "Batch has expired"
Withdraw material → Immediately settle for same day → Verify settlement document generated correctly
Execute settlement for period with zero consignment withdrawals → Verify system displays "No data found" or empty settlement document
Material price changes mid-period → Withdraw before and after price change → Verify settlement uses price at time of each withdrawal
Enter withdrawal quantity with 3 decimal places (e.g., 10.125 KG) → Verify posting accepts and processes correctly
Withdraw consignment material with moving average price = 0 → Verify posting succeeds with zero-value accounting entry

INT.details: Consignment withdrawal triggered by production order goods issue → Verify automatic Movement Type 411 posted → Verify production order references consignment withdrawal
Withdraw consignment stock to quality inspection → Approve batch → Transfer to unrestricted → Verify batch chain maintained
Settlement document price differs from vendor invoice price → Verify invoice blocked for review → Manual price adjustment → Invoice posted

scenarioAreas.name: Consignment Stock Access and Availability
failureScenarios: User cannot access Post Goods Movement app → Production delay
No consignment stock available for material/vendor/batch → Withdrawal blocked
Wrong storage location selected → Incorrect stock reduced
scenarioAreas.mitigation: Authorization testing, Stock availability validation, Location verification

scenarioAreas.name: Ownership Transfer and Financial Posting
failureScenarios: Ownership transfer fails → Material remains vendor-owned
Liability posting missing → Vendor not credited, financial statement incorrect
Wrong price used → Valuation error, vendor underpaid/overpaid
Accounting document not generated → Financial reconciliation failure
scenarioAreas.mitigation: Financial integration testing, Price validation, Posting verification, Accounting reconciliation

scenarioAreas.name: Batch Traceability
failureScenarios: Batch number lost in transfer → Regulatory non-compliance (FDA audit failure)
Batch genealogy broken → Cannot trace material in recall scenario
Expired batch allowed → Quality violation, patient safety risk
scenarioAreas.mitigation: Batch flow verification, Expiry date validation, Genealogy chain testing

scenarioAreas.name: Settlement Document Generation
failureScenarios: Settlement document incomplete → Vendor under-billed, revenue loss
Wrong period applied → Billing disputes, delayed payment
Batch details missing → Cannot reconcile with vendor records
Settlement fails for cross-plant withdrawals → Manual intervention required
scenarioAreas.mitigation: Period boundary testing, Data completeness verification, Multi-plant scenario testing

scenarioAreas.name: Invoice Verification Automation
failureScenarios: Automatic invoice creation fails → Manual processing required, delay
Price mismatch → Invoice blocked, requires manual clearing
GR/IR account not cleared → Open items accumulate, month-end reconciliation issue
scenarioAreas.mitigation: Invoice matching validation, Price consistency check, GR/IR clearing verification

scenarioAreas.name: Error Handling and Data Validation
failureScenarios: Zero/negative quantity accepted → Invalid movement posted
Insufficient consignment stock not detected → Overdrawn stock, negative inventory
Invalid vendor/batch combination allowed → Incorrect liability posting
Backdated posting without authorization → Audit violation
scenarioAreas.mitigation: Input validation testing, Negative testing, Authorization boundary testing

riskAssessment.justification: 1. Financial Impact: Direct impact on inventory valuation (balance sheet) and vendor liability (accounts payable). 2. Regulatory Compliance: Batch traceability is mandatory for FDA/EMA-regulated biologics. 3. Business Criticality: High-value materials (biologics cost $1,000-$100,000/kg) — errors = significant financial loss. 4. Process Complexity: Multi-module integration (MM + FI + Batch Management) with automatic postings. 5. Data Integrity: Consignment stock segregation failure = financial misstatement (audit risk). 6. Vendor Relationship: Incorrect settlement = vendor disputes, payment delays, supply disruption.

masterData: Material Master with consignment indicator active (MARC-KZECH = 'X')
Vendor Master with consignment agreement (LFM1 consignment info record)
Info Record with consignment liabilities account (EINE)
Consignment stock already posted via GR against consignment PO (Movement Type 101, special stock 'K')
configuration: Movement Type 411 configured for consignment withdrawal
Automatic account determination for consignment liability (GBB account)
Number ranges for material documents, accounting documents, settlement documents
Evaluated Receipt Settlement (ERS) configured for automatic invoice creation (if AC-5 required)
authorization: M_MSEG_BWA with activity 01 (Create) for Movement Type 411
M_MSEG_BWE for backdated postings (if AP-5 required)
